title: Factory images catalog (version 2)
description: Catalog read by .github/workflows/build-images.yaml. Keep it at .github/images.json in the repository that owns the images.

registry.description: Registry prefix for published images, without a trailing slash. Required when any run publishes.

tag_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to every published tag.

default_branch_tags.description: Alias tags (for example latest) published with the sha and ref tags on trusted default-branch runs. Not published on release tags, pull requests, or other branches. Each builder applies its own tag prefix. An image can override this list with its own default_branch_tags.

release.description: Release tag mapping. Defaults: tag_regex ^([^/]+)/(v.+)$, service_match 1, version_match 2, publish_tag ${ref_name}, source_ref ${ref_name}.

service.description: Optional template rendered from the captures; supports ${service}, ${version}, ${ref_name}.

publish_tag.description: Rendered publish tag. Defaults to ${ref_name}, the sanitized full ref name (for example svc-v1.2.3 for svc/v1.2.3).

shared_paths.description: Changed-file patterns that plan every image and package. A pattern ending in /** matches everything below that directory. A pattern starting with ! excludes files: a changed file matches when it matches at least one positive pattern and no negative pattern.

packages.description: Melange packages, keyed by name. Images reference them through builders.apko.needs_packages.

pre_build.description: Repository script, run during planning. Each stdout line must be KEY=VALUE. The pairs are added to package build environments and to docker build arguments.

config.description: Melange configuration path. Defaults to melange/<name>.yaml.

runner_profile.description: Runner profile per architecture. Defaults to standard.

source.description: Source repository checked out before the build. A path of '.' for the calling repository without ref plans as the calling repository checkout. A path of '.' for any other repository, or with a ref, checks out under .package-sources/<package> and builds with root.

repository.description: owner/name. Defaults to the calling repository.

path.description: Checkout path, relative to the workspace. Defaults to '.'.

root.description: Build as if the checkout were the workspace root: the melange configuration, the pipelines directory, cache_key_files and the source directory resolve inside the checkout. Defaults to true when path is '.', otherwise false. A path of '.' with root false is rejected. Not valid for the calling repository checkout.

submodules.description: Submodule checkout of the calling repository, for a package with no source or built from the calling repository at the root (source omitted). Defaults to false.

archs.description: Melange architectures. Untrusted runs build x86_64 only.

build_env.description: KEY=VALUE lines added to the melange environment.

primary.description: Builder that gets the canonical tags. Required when both builders are set. The other builder's tags are prefixed with its name and a dash.

archs.description: Defaults to amd64 and arm64. Untrusted runs build amd64 only.

default_branch_tags.description: Overrides the top-level default_branch_tags for this image. An empty array publishes no alias tags for this image.

paths.description: Changed-file patterns that plan this image on pull_request and push. Same syntax as shared_paths: a leading ! excludes matching files, so a file selects the image only when a positive pattern matches it and no negative pattern does.

commands.description: Each string is split on whitespace into an entrypoint and arguments.

script.description: Repository script run with IMAGE and IMAGE_ARCH set.

verify_version.description: Require a command to print the release version on release tags.

mode.description: build runs a Dockerfile. bake runs docker-bake.hcl. ko builds a Go package with ko into a container image; context is the Go module directory.

set.description: bake mode only: KEY=VALUE variables passed to docker/bake-action.

importpath.description: ko mode only: Go package to build, relative to context. Defaults to ./cmd.

ko_config.description: ko mode only: ko configuration file (for example .ko.yaml), relative to the repository root. Empty uses ko defaults.

go_version_file.description: ko mode only: go.mod used by setup-go, relative to the repository root. Defaults to <context>/go.mod.

ldflags.description: ko mode only: go build ldflags values, each passed as one --ldflags value. ko splits a value on commas, so values must not contain commas.

env.description: ko mode only: environment for the ko build, KEY=VALUE strings.

tag_prefix.description: Tag prefix for this builder. Overrides the default: empty for the primary builder, the builder name and a dash for the secondary builder. The top-level tag_prefix is still prepended.

archs.description: Architectures this builder publishes. Overrides the image archs for this builder only. Defaults to the image archs. Untrusted runs build amd64 only.

runner_profile.description: Runner profile for this builder's publish leg on trusted runs, per architecture (apko and ko publish in one leg on the amd64 runner). Defaults to standard. Untrusted runs always use the standard runner.

events.description: Contexts in which this builder is planned: pull_request (pull requests and merge groups), push, schedule, release (release tags), workflow_dispatch. Defaults to all of them. An image with no builder planned for the context is skipped.

smoke.description: Smoke test for this builder. Replaces the image smoke entirely for this builder. An empty object disables smoke for this builder.

commands.description: Each string is split on whitespace into an entrypoint and arguments.

script.description: Repository script run with IMAGE and IMAGE_ARCH set.

verify_version.description: Require a command to print the release version on release tags.

config.description: apko configuration path. Defaults to apko/<image>.yaml. Ignored when configs is set.

configs.description: Variants. Each produces its own publish leg. Only the variant with an empty tag_suffix is smoke tested.

needs_packages.description: Names from the packages map whose APK repositories the build needs.

tag_prefix.description: Tag prefix for this builder. Overrides the default: empty for the primary builder, the builder name and a dash for the secondary builder. The top-level tag_prefix is still prepended.

archs.description: Architectures this builder publishes. Overrides the image archs for this builder only. Defaults to the image archs. Untrusted runs build amd64 only.

runner_profile.description: Runner profile for this builder's publish leg on trusted runs, per architecture (apko and ko publish in one leg on the amd64 runner). Defaults to standard. Untrusted runs always use the standard runner.
